name: Pisgah Covered Bridge
facts: Built in 1911 by J. J. Welch for just $40, the 54‑foot Pisgah Covered Bridge once carried daily traffic before a newer concrete span replaced it in the 1950s.
After a 2003 flood washed it away, volunteers salvaged 90 % of the original wood and restored the bridge in 2004, re‑shingling its roof to match the historic design.
Today, the Pisgah Covered Bridge welcomes visitors daily from dawn to dusk, offering a quarter‑mile woodland trail that passes footbridges and a baptismal pool downstream.
